operative_context: The system shall allow the user to set a new password only if the reset link is valid and has not expired.
The system shall allow users to initiate a password reset process if they forget their password.
The system shall invalidate all active sessions after a successful password change or reset.
The system shall validate the reset link before allowing the user to set a new password.
The system shall require the user to provide their current password when changing their password.
The system shall require the user to create a password during registration.
The system shall allow authenticated users to change their password.
The system shall invalidate the reset link after successful password reset.
